observations: Three photos show a bare internal-combustion engine block, no transmission, no hybrid inverter or motor-generator unit visible.
Engine sits on wet ground amid other plastic-wrapped engines, consistent with a used/tokunbo parts yard.
A white sticker on the valve cover reads something like 'FM15D-E2B' with a barcode and '109', plus handwritten teal marker '07/6' or similar.
No manufacturer logo (Toyota or otherwise) is legible in any photo.
Injector wiring, timing chain cover, and fuel rail are visible but covered in grime/oil residue typical of a used pull.
A yellow paint/glue blob and some surface rust/corrosion are visible on mounting brackets.
No photo shows the engine running, no compression test, no VIN plate, no accompanying wiring harness or ECU.

identity.kind: used small-displacement petrol engine (possibly 3-cylinder, as claimed)

claims.claim: This is the M15D-FXE / M15A-FXE 1.5-liter, 3-cylinder Atkinson-cycle petrol hybrid engine
claims.evidence: Sticker in photo 0/1/2 shows a code resembling 'FM15D-E2B', not a clearly legible 'M15D-FXE' or 'M15A-FXE', and no Toyota logo or VIN plate is visible to confirm make or exact variant.

risks.risk: Engine code on sticker does not clearly match the claimed hybrid model code, so this could be a different or lower-value non-hybrid engine.
risks.proof: Close-up, in-focus photo of the full engine code sticker and any cast engine ID on the block itself.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic small petrol engine, not the specific hybrid variant

risks.risk: No hybrid motor-generator, inverter, or battery pack is shown, so the 'hybrid' claim may only apply to the ICE portion, which changes resale value versus a complete hybrid powertrain.
risks.proof: Photo of the hybrid transaxle/motor unit and inverter if included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as engine-only (ICE block), not a complete hybrid drivetrain

risks.risk: Running condition is unverifiable from static photos; internal wear, compression loss, or timing issues cannot be seen.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking/running with audible idle, plus a compression test reading.

risks.risk: Mileage/history unknown; corrosion and surface rust suggest age or exposure to moisture, possibly affecting internals.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or import paperwork showing mileage.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (ECU, wiring harness, sensors) that are often needed for installation are not shown.
risks.proof: Photo list of all included parts/harness bundled with the engine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare block only, accessories not included

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the full engine code sticker and any stamped/cast engine number on the block.
Video of the engine cranking or running, with audible sound.
Photo of the hybrid motor-generator/inverter unit if it is part of the sale.
Compression test results or oil pressure check if available.
List/photo of all included accessories (harness, ECU, sensors).
response.reason: The claimed hybrid Atkinson engine model cannot be confirmed from the blurry sticker alone, and no hybrid drivetrain components are visible, so even a worst-case price cannot be set until the engine code and included parts are clarified.
